findings.folded_into: a layout correction for the efit-comparison figure family
findings.summary: Every one of the fifteen panels spends well over half its canvas on empty margin. The vessel spans about 245 of 1399 px (17%) of the canvas width, leaving roughly 60% of the 14 x 7.2 in canvas blank on either side, while the twelve flux levels are packed into that narrow band. At the ~900 px column the published page uses, the plasma renders about 160 px wide with roughly 2 px between adjacent contours, so the level detail the panel exists to show is on the edge of merging. Cropping the panel to the vessel bounding box with a small pad would put the ink in the canvas instead of the margin. The finding applies to the whole family, not to this file alone.

findings.folded_into: a legend-truthfulness correction for panels with an empty series
findings.summary: The legend offers two series, 'imas-efit' in grey and 'nova' in blue, but no blue mark appears anywhere in this panel: every contour, the wall and the single axis triangle are grey. A reader who does not read the caption cannot tell whether nova is absent or exactly coincident. The caption does explain the absence (a positive-flux vacuum-like state against negative levels), so the panel is not misleading on the page, but the image alone is. Drop the empty series from the legend or label it 'no level in range'.

findings.folded_into: a legend-truthfulness correction for panels with an empty series
findings.summary: Same defect as the ITER terminal panel: a two-series legend over a panel in which only grey contours appear. The caption states that no blue contour is visible on this level array, so the figure is honest once its caption is read, but the rendered picture advertises a series it does not show.

findings.folded_into: a legend-truthfulness correction for panels with an empty series
findings.summary: Two-series legend, single visible grey series, caption declaring that no nova contour reaches these levels. Same disposition as the MAST-U fitted-start panel.

findings.folded_into: a boundary-closure and null-marker check for the comparison panels
findings.summary: The blue nova set is not a closed family inside the vessel: it runs as a narrow band along the inner wall for the full height and continues through the wall polygon into the lower divertor, ending in short stroke fragments outside the plasma region. The grey reference set is the closed nested family a reader expects. A comparison panel whose subject is how two flux maps agree cannot be read cleanly when one of them escapes the boundary it is meant to be bounded by, and the wall is drawn so the reader sees the crossing. The caption also says the panel is drawn 'with the wall and reference nulls', but no null marker of either set is drawn anywhere on this panel.

findings.folded_into: a coincident-null-marker correction for the comparison panels
findings.summary: At the lower stationary point the blue hollow saddle marker is drawn on top of the grey filled saddle marker, and the two occupy essentially the same point (about x=650, y=555), so neither style is readable there. The caption claims both null sets are drawn in their own styles and that those styles distinguish them; at this null they do not. Either offset a coincident pair or state that the two saddles coincide.

findings.exempted_reason: The marker is legible and the overlap is with a one-pixel wall stroke the reader can follow through it, so no data is hidden. Recorded so a later redraw can offset it; it does not justify a node of its own.
findings.summary: In one of the two MAST-U replay panels at the same stated relative L2, a blue hollow replay-saddle marker sits directly on the inner-wall stroke at the midplane (about x=610, y=347), where marker ink and wall ink coincide. The marker is still identifiable by shape, so this does not stop a reader, but a marker that overlaps the boundary it is measured against reads as a wall feature rather than a data feature.

findings.folded_into: a caption-trim for the efit-comparison evidence fragment
findings.summary: Reader-facing captions carry measurement and process text that belongs in the evidence record, not under a figure: the fitted-inputs panels state native pytest walls ('Native pytest: 1 passed in 966.34s (0:16:06)'), function and process walls, and the ordering of a receipt relative to a native exit code. These lines do not help a reader interpret the picture and they bury the numbers that do (relative L2, the level array, which states are compared). The same pattern repeats at lines 1445, 1509, 1533, 1622 and 1666.

findings.folded_into: a figure-preview provenance record in the evidence fragment
findings.summary: The attachment set reaches a reviewer as image-0.png through image-14.png with no image-to-figure mapping recorded anywhere in the dispatch, so every finding in this record had to be matched to a figure by re-identifying the picture against the captions. Two MAST-U replay panels at the same stated 24.69% relative L2 cannot be separated that way at all. Recording the figure path beside each rendered preview at dispatch time would remove the ambiguity for every later figure review of this run.

mapping_basis: The dispatch recorded no image-to-figure map, so each attachment was identified from the rendered PNG alone on three independent signals: (1) legend text, which reads 'nova current replay' on exactly the seven row-replay figures and 'nova' on the eight non-replay figures, matching the two counts exactly; (2) vessel geometry, which separates the MAST-U double-divertor box (7 panels), the TCV tall chamfered rectangle (5) and the ITER D (3), again matching the figure count per machine; (3) which series each caption declares visible, which separates the two ITER non-replay panels (grey-only versus grey-plus-blue) and both fitted-start panels (declared no visible blue). The row-replay panels of one machine are ordered by the contour separation visible in the PNG, which tracks the caption's stated full-map relative L2. image-7 and image-11, both carrying a 24.69% caption, are not separable from the picture; no finding below depends on which of that pair is which.
review_limitations: Attachment identifiers carry no provenance; every mapping above is inferred from the rendered picture and the reviewed run's own captions, and one pair (image-7 / image-11, both MAST-U replays at the same 24.69% L2) cannot be separated visually. Verdicts rest on the 15 rendered PNGs only; no SVG was opened, read or rendered.
review_notes: Judged from the 15 rendered PNGs only. No blocking finding survived: no label is clipped, no two labels overlap, no text falls below the contrast of its background, no panel uses a gradient, fill or decorative shading, and no panel depicts information that is naturally a table. The defects recorded are of three kinds: canvas layout that puts the ink in the minority of the panel, legends or captions that advertise a series or a marker the picture does not deliver, and boundary or marker coincidence that costs the reader part of the comparison. Each is non-blocking because the caption, or the picture's own remaining geometry, still lets a reader recover the comparison.
